response.sql:
WITH filtered_fees AS (
  SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, rebrate, feerate
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
),
per_order_stats AS (
  SELECT orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(CASE WHEN rebrate IS NOT NULL AND feerate IS NOT NULL AND feerate != 0 THEN rebrate / feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM per_order_stats
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT pos.orderslink, pos.avg_rebtotal, pos.avg_ratio,
    CASE WHEN om.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN pos.avg_ratio / om.overall_avg_ratio ELSE NULL END as relative_ratio
  FROM per_order_stats pos
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
)
SELECT orderslink, avg_rebtotal, avg_ratio, relative_ratio
FROM normalized
ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The phrase 'clear the 0.0005 maker rebate rate threshold' is interpreted as rebrate >= 0.0005 (meeting or equaling the threshold value).
